units: SI except explicit rpm/mm-derived original dimensions/temperature/flow

formulae.rotating_reference_gear_loss_W: output_torque_Nm * output_speed_rad_s * (1/eta - 1), only at nonzero speed

efficiency_note: 0.70 is catalogue reference; 0.55/0.85 are requested sensitivity assumptions. Static efficiency mapping is requested algebra, not measured holding torque or friction/backdrive model.
demand_note: Gear catalogue T0=1600/3724Nm chosen only as component comparison input, not actual Gorilla torque requirement. Other output demands scale linearly in the algebraic model.
continuous_condition_note: Coils100C/mount20C and vendor current conditions; Tc and Ts are distinct. Actual motor torque-speed curve at each nonzero speed remains unknown; nmax@Umax@Tc is one published boundary point, not a universal speed limit at lower torque.
additional_unknowns: full motor torque-speed voltage curve at selected winding and bus
dynamic torque/current and actual loss at requested duty
static gear holding friction/backdrive and thermal conditions
total joint mass and geometric fit
arithmetic_review_scope: eta0.70 input speed, torque demand, capped Ts/Tc mapping, and nmax@Tc interpretation; independent read-only subagent review agreed
